method: Independent stdlib XML comparison by named component/field. All attributes and text retained; numeric values parsed and vectors retained. XML property ordering is ignored; PathPointSet and PathWrapSet object order is explicitly preserved. GeometryPath component name normalizes only serialization variants geometrypath/path. Full Appearance and other metadata remain compared.

numeric_tolerance.interpretation: Serialization identity only; not a physical uncertainty, subject qualification or causal threshold.

limits: AB06 ForceSet component reordering is recorded explicitly. Physical by-name equality does not by itself attest order-dependent controller or control-vector behavior in a future dynamic run; this audit neither changes runtime nor invokes a new rollout.
No model build, OpenSim load, FK, dynamics, IK solver or integration is performed.
Both rebuilt whole IK references match the corresponding old files byte for byte. Mass/inertia roundoff does not enter the direct frozen-pose contact law.
